themes.label: Login failures across app versions
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report repeated login failures, including generic error messages like "unable to log you in," forced logouts right after signing in, and having to reinstall the app or use the desktop site to access accounts. Many tie the problem to a specific app update, and some note that FaceID is ignored or that login only works on Wi-Fi rather than mobile data.
themes.recommendation: Pull authentication and session error logs segmented by app version, OS, and network type (mobile data vs. Wi-Fi) for the releases cited in reviews (v8.28.x, v23.x, v26.06 and later), and identify the failing step, such as token refresh, session persistence, or biometric re-auth, to scope a hotfix.

themes.label: Credit card payment flow regression
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say the v26.06 update replaced the one-tap Pay Card action, which pre-filled statement and current balances, with a bill payment flow that requires adding the card as a payee, reselecting the card, and manually typing the amount. Several reviewers say they now risk paying the wrong amount or leaving interest-bearing balance unpaid, and some threaten to switch banks. One reviewer reports that a later update (v26.08.2) restored the functionality, while most others are still asking for the old behaviour back.
themes.recommendation: Audit the v26.06.0 Pay Card flow against v26.08.2 to confirm which balance pre-population behaviour was restored, then add a regression test covering Pay Card on Android and iOS that verifies statement and current balances are pre-filled without requiring a new payee.

themes.label: Login failures and connectivity errors
themes.summary: Users report the app frequently failing to log in, showing false "no internet connection" or "loading" errors, and crashing or stalling on bill payments, account views, and trade-time access. Several say the problem appears on mobile data but not home Wi-Fi, and reviews span Android and iOS across versions from 2018 to 2026. One review describes severe distress caused by repeated sign-in failures and should be routed to support for follow-up.
themes.recommendation: Investigate login and API timeout handling on cellular networks for Android and iOS by comparing failure rates on mobile data versus Wi-Fi across the v23.x and v26.x releases, and add a ticket to review the support escalation path for customers reporting distress from repeated access failures.

themes.label: App requires OS update, locks out older iPhones
themes.summary: Users on older iPhones, mostly iOS 13 or 14 devices, say the latest TD app version (around v25.08) requires a newer iOS and blocks access to their accounts entirely, even though the App Store will not offer them an update. Several users also describe update loops, and some note they cannot afford a new phone, so they feel forced out of online banking. Android and newer-iOS reports of crashes and login errors after recent releases also appear in the cluster.
themes.recommendation: Pull the minimum iOS version data from recent releases and audit which builds raised the floor, then restore access for devices on the prior supported iOS version (or ship a fallback that lets older devices reach account login) and add a pre-update compatibility check that warns or routes users to a supported build instead of a dead-end update loop.

themes.label: App login failures and outages
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS, spanning several app versions over the years, report the TD app frequently failing to log them in, freezing, showing loading loops, or claiming no connection even when their internet works. Several say they have had to call TD or visit a branch to check balances or make payments, and some are considering switching banks. Recent reviews on v26.x suggest the problem persists.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash, authentication, and API error logs segmented by app version (v26.08.x and v26.09.x first) and platform to identify whether login timeouts or session-handling changes are causing the 'no connection' and forced logout errors, then set a reliability target and track it per release.

themes.label: Redesign backlash and missing dark mode icon
themes.summary: Users are split between a 2023 visual redesign they find ugly, cluttered, and too white or bright, and a later complaint that the dark mode app icon disappeared in 2025 even though in-app dark mode was added. Many reviewers ask for a dark mode option, a return of the old green or background, or an icon that changes with the iOS home screen theme. Several reviews are iOS-only and tie the icon issue to iOS 18 and later app versions.
themes.recommendation: Investigate the iOS dark mode app icon regression in versions 25.02 to 25.04.1 by checking the alternate icon and automatic appearance asset configuration, then ship a dedicated dark icon and publish a timeline in release notes.

themes.label: Praise: fast, easy banking
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are overwhelmingly praising TD Canada for quick service, easy navigation, and reliable everyday tasks like e-transfers, cheque and mobile deposits, and bill payments. Several reviewers also highlight friendly branch staff and trust in TD as a brick-and-mortar institution, with mentions of seniors and small business owners. The praise appears on both iOS and Android across recent app versions.
themes.recommendation: Protect the e-transfer, mobile cheque deposit, and bill payment flows in regression testing for each release, and track their completion time as a success metric so these strengths are not degraded by future changes.

themes.label: Praise: easy navigation and reliability
themes.summary: Users in this cluster overwhelmingly praise the TD Canada app as easy to use, straightforward to navigate, and reliable, with many saying it has worked without issues for them across recent versions on both iOS and Android. A few reviewers note a mention of improved stability over older releases, and one older Android review mentions NFC payments failing and a dislike of the login screen design.
themes.recommendation: Protect the navigation and reliability experience by adding these praised flows (account overview, saving and investing) to the regression test suite for each release, and monitor the NFC payment and login screen feedback separately to confirm whether it still applies in current versions.

Pourquoi changer un téléphone qui fonctionne parfaitement... parce que TD en a décidé ainsi? Pas fort TD Why change a working phone because TD decided I must upgrade. Bad decision TD

My friend tells me that she’s had the Bank of Montreal app on her iPhone6s and her iPad mini for years and has never had to face a “mandatory update”, let alone a total inability to use the app. BofM must be updating its app “on the fly”. MAYBE TRY BOFM?!

reviews.t: I can’t believe I can’t use the app because I have an old phone!
reviews.x: For years I have been able to use the TD app .. loved it and it performed in a simple manner - as is all I need. Now, I have an mandatory update - but because my phone is old - I can’t continue to use the app! Wow! Is TD in the banking business or phone sale business??? I just want to view my accounts - and pay a few bills! I want to bypass the ‘update’ - I’m sure it’s an easy task and still protecting my privacy!

Probably the worst banking app I've used, currently can't even log in and when I can 90% of the app is just trying to sell me additional banking services rather than presenting information I actually want. Seriously, invest a little of that money you pay your execs into making a working app for your customers. Edit Can't log in again, 'Something went wrong on our end, call some phone number to be hung up on my our smooth-brained support staff'. Typical

Traveling and tried to pay bill with app. Tried to enter date to pay bill and app logs out. No error, no calender to change date just logs out. At one time asked if I wanted to send feedback, said yes and tried to type issue and app just logged out. These are pretty basic use but still does not work. No way to contact support so logging review in play store in case support reviews.

Hi I have an IPhone 5 which suddenly is not able to be updated therefore Today I cannot pay my monthly bills using my phone . I am not able to buy a new phone today so what do I do ? Switch banks after over 50 years of banking with TD ? This is very frustrating as I had no warning that I would happen ! Bonnie

I’m thoroughly disappointed that new updates now require iOS 13 or later. I can no longer use the app because of this. Wish they could have considered that people with older phones are still using the app. So disappointed

This TD app worked fine on my iPad with iOS 12.5.7 until now. This move to iOS 13 is super inconvenient, feels like I’m being forced to buy a new iPad by TD. It won’t allow me to run the last compatible version which the instructions tell me to do. This used to be 4 star app now it should be negative stars.
Top notch! 😄

I can’t stand when apps do this and won’t continue to allow the current compatible app to work on these older devices with older operating systems. This is the forced cash grab these device manufacturers do all the time. Well I guess I’m done with this app now. I’m not gonna be forced to get a new phone just to keep up to date to use the apps.

Can't log in half the time, keeps loading and then spits out an error. Seems to be the same issue another reviewer mentioned, where the app won't work unless connected to wifi. Edit: I don't want to sit on the phone to fix an issue that's clearly not unique to me. I'm on a Pixel 6, and I feel like that's everything you really need to know.

Slowly getting worse. Been using this app for as long as I can remember. Got behind alot of the new features and tweaks they've done over the years. And now, this app is horrible. Can't log in. Ive been using the accurate and up to date info and still denies me access. After multiple attempts, it'll log me in but seconds later, kicks me out for no reason. Please sort this out.
They updated the app and my I can no longer use it on my I pad Cheaper to change banks

Td has the slowest app BY FAR of any other bank. Thier servers seem to be on 286 machines from the 80's. 80% of the time i wont even be able to access my account. If you want to do a stock trade or oney transfer, get ready to fight with the app for about 5 minutes of hung pages and refreshing. Td makes a lot of money and is a huge bank. Its embaressing that thier app os this inept.

For the past month or so I have been having issues logging in. It either tells me that it cannot retrieve my login credentials or that there is no interest connection, which is not true as everything else on my phone is working and getting really good signal and speeds. This only happens when I am on mobile data as when I connect to WiFi, I can finally use to the app to login to do my banking.

reviews.t: This might force me to change banks once and for all
reviews.x: My phone won’t support the upgrade required by your app for online banking. My phone is sufficient enough for all of my other apps, including several other bank apps. I have had my TD account for more than twenty years, if this app upgrade issue is not resolved, I will start banking elsewhere. I hope it can, I have been a loyal customer because TD bank usually gets it right.

I am fed up with the continued lack of consideration for Seniors on fixed incomes by site designers/operators - in this case TD, and of course Apple...having migrated all my banking to online on my iPad mini, I now find it no longer is upgradeable to IOS 13, and so if I wish to continue to bank on line, an expenditure of probably over $500.00 is required. This amounts to an entire month’s CPP - despite the fact that there is technically nothing wrong with my iPad. Surely there’s a way to support legacy software for longer time periods that are more in keeping with the actual physical condition of the hardware? Yours sincerely D. L. Morgan, P.Eng, Retd.

Used to be good, now it's awful. I used to be able to log in without any issue through biometrics. Now it makes me reestablish biometrics every time I try to log in. Trying to log in through password is still sketchy. It's still iffy. Either the network is down or there's some sort of error or the app forgets I exist. I tried to uninstall it and reinstall, I still get the same errors. It was awesome up until a couple weeks ago. Did something happen? I don't want to have to switch banks over this

Just like everyone else, I'm not able to access my online banking through the app. It constantly says cannot retrieve info, error or no connection. It's everyday multiple times a day. The app needs to be fixed. We pay monthly account fees and get charged every other fee possible, but can't even see what is going on? Can't deposit etransfers or access funds. What are we paying premium monthly rates for?? 🤔

Please fix this app. Errors when logging in.. ' sorry it's not you. It's us. ' Errors when paying bills. Oops something went wrong. So try again, same error. But , it actually PAYS the bill ! Resulting in having to go back in and canceling the multiple payments made. As of today's date the app is NOT usable.

*update: works fine now Wont let me log in. I put in the password and it immediately comes up with error "for your protection, your session expired due to a lack of activity" if the app worked it would get a much better rating. That finally got sorted, but now months later it won't allow me to log in for a few months it's been saying it's not you, it's us. Please try again later!

Making a bank app with a IOS requirement base is making a bank app useful to Apple, NOT to your REAL customers who now HAVE TO update either their systems, apps OR even get new devices to be able to go with your updates.

reviews.t: I am extremely upset; poor thought on TD’s end
reviews.x: As of today (April 17/23), I can no longer access my TD account info by cell phone; why?... because I have an older phone. My phone works fine... I am not interested in pouring money in to a new phone when it’s not warranted. I am sure I’m not the only one. It would be appreciated if this was considered before implementing changes that impact clients.
Now I can’t do banking thanks a lot.

reviews.t: TD is not supporting older customers
reviews.x: No all of us have been newest phones... my phone won’t allow ISO13... do better.. before we leave you and take our $

My iPhone doesn’t have iso 13 or higher. I am not going out to buy a new iPhone when this one works fine. Your company need to correct this major problem an I cannot be the only customer that has this issue!! I need this app to work on this iPhone!!! I am not going to purchase a new iPhone. “Fix this issue”

I thought I was the only one struggling with logging in but looking at other reviews, it's definitely the app. Every other day it says "unable to log you in" or retrieve information or something and then I can't log in. I have to reinstall every other day to the point where I just go on my computer now. It's frustrating because I bank on the go a lot and love being able to check things on my phone. It seems 2023 it has a bad bug. I hope the login/connection issues can be fixed soon....

You have to fix this app. And your webpage login. On the app it doesn't remember your biometric settings, and asks you to login every time, then fails. Your webpage now asks me to use 2 factor authentication every time I log in, even though I set it to only ask occasionally. This is unacceptable from a major bank, fix it. I have never been so frustrated with your service and I have been using your bank for 20 years, if you don't fix it, I'm going to another bank. No I won't call you either.

C’est le message que tous les propriétaires de iPhone 6 reçoivent! Merci d’avoir rendu votre app incompatible et d’empêcher que l’on puisse continuer à utiliser la version qui fonctionnait très bien (sur des iPhone qui fonctionnent très bien encore). Heureusement que ça fonctionne encore sur le Web. Je donne 5 comme note de la version de la semaine dernière mais 0 à la nouvelle (comme pour un devoir non remis!).

The latest update broke support for iOS 12.5.7. As older iPhones can not be updated to iOS 13x. The App no longer works. Either TD does not care about their customers or the release team missed a critical defect.

If I'm on mobile data, the app simply won't work. When I'm on wifi, it works perfectly. What the hell? With this and the fact that it doesn't support Google pay, it almost makes me want to change banks. It's ridiculous that a very rich bank cannot find programmers that can give you a decent mobile experience.

Decent design. But biometrics randomly turns off and I'm forced to use a password. For something that ought to be secure the app would rather go with a password that could potentially be found by anyone. Honestly fix this. If you can't, hire a third party with the know how to make your app. Also why don't we have notifications for deposits, withdrawals, etc?
Very easy to use. I have no problem using the TD app.

Came here to see if anyone else is having the same frustrating and very disappointing network connection error. TD Canada, surely this has reached your ears and eyes. Don't you think it's high time you did something about this? And what's even more concerning is, it allows me to connect to the app IF I AM USING A PUBLIC WI-FI. But my personal mobile data, not a chance. WHY? A public Wi-fi, really? In case you guys haven't gotten the memo yet, everyone else is saying the same thing, FIX . IT !!

Complete toss up whenever I need to log in. Sometimes it works and sometimes it doesnt. Actually most of the time it doesn't work. Get messages saying I'm "not connected to internet" or "something went wrong on our end" been happening for months. Get it sorted ASAP this is very inconvenient.

Major bug when installing TD on a new phone when it was installed on another phone. Basically, the login info that TD chooses to send to the cloud (Google Drive) as a backup for use when formatting the device clashes with the installation of the app on a new phone (constant crashing of the app). No number of reinstalls of the app fixed the problem. It's only once I did a FRESH install of Android (no restore from another device when performing setup) that I was able to login to the app without a problem. I sent a detailed email to customer support, hopefully this gets fixed. EDIT: Another workaround is to clear Google Play Services data and uninstall/reinstall the app. That worked for me!

I love being able to check my accounts, but this app has started F*ing up since they took out the mobile payment. I can't use it on my data, it always has to be on wifi. If I'm on my data and I need to check my accounts, I need to go to EasyWeb TD banking website because I can't access the darn app. I thought the whole purpose of having a banking app was to be able to use it anywhere at anytime. I even tried deleting the caxhe and storage, then un and re installing to no avail... Please help!
OK/groomer! And I’m out….off to the next bank!
Don’t upgrade the app to force buying new phones !!!!

Used to be an excellent app but for the last 4 or 5 months I can't deposit my cheques no matter how many photos I take, no matter the lighting, no matter how polished my camera lens, no matter how dark the surface it seems to not be able to see the amount clearly enough to complete the transaction, for years mobile deposits were flawless, now I get to relive the worst part of the 90s and hang out in a lineup at the bank, might just pack up and go to RBC they have way better perks and incentives

Fix your app!!! Whenever I try log in while on my 5G I get server errors or no internet connection errors, and all other apps on my phone work just fine. The problem disappears as soon as I switch to wi-fi. If this can help your dev team, my device is a Samsung Galaxy A53, jyst a few months old, and I always update it to the latest Android version. As I can see from other comments on here, I am not the only one with this problem.

The app just doesnt function more than half of the time. When it decides to work, it shows messages like we have locked your account for security reasons and when trying to call the customer care, you are on hold forever, like 1.5 hours until you get automatically disconnected. Its the worst app.

App used to be pretty good, but the last few months have been awful. It constantly has trouble logging in, saying no internet connection, data or wifi. It's pretty frustrating considering how much TD charges for a lot of their services. Definitely looking at other banking solutions currently since I use this app everyday and can't have something unreliable.

Like alot of other users of this app....it will not log in when on data...wifi no issues...made the phone calls to TD ...the same one they tell everyone to call...they have no fix...told will open a service investication ticket ..funny...no email sent to me confirming ticket number. Poor customer service...told we haven't heard of any issue that I am discribing. Nothing but a load of bull!!! Basically app is useless unless you are on wifi.

The app used to be decent. The point of this app is to make my banking easier. Over the last few months, 90% of the time, it won't log in, constantly saying that it's unable to retrieve the information, or no internet connection. When it does manage to log in, everything is slow or it'll say something like " an error has occurred on our end, please retry or call us". It happened so often that I just give up and go on the website. It's become so inconvenient that I'm considering changing banks.

This app is convenient but only when it actually decides to work. Half the time any page you try to load just fails. Or there are constant technical "improvements" being done. Doesn't seem like it. For how many customers you have, you'd think you would try to stay competitive with other banks and the convenience of their apps and phone pay methods.

I usually love the app but what have you guys done to it this year??? It just doesn't allow me to login, and keeps saying "Unfortunately we're not able to log you in right now. Please try again later". Looks like a buggy update in 2023 which has caused many to fret. Are you working on fixing it soon?

Constant lag. While using mobile data, it slams me with a "No internet connection" every time I try to log in. It will eventually let you log in, that is to say, only after about five or six attempts and reloads. It does the same between menus. I've accidentally double transferred into accounts because of this and spend at least ten to fifteen minutes trying to get even the simplest of tasks done.
The app should have notification options for any deposits or expenditures.

Been a great app until I got the pixel 7 pro. Now the app keeps saying "no internet connection" even though I have full 5G bars. After a bunch of attempts and a couple phone throws across the room I can get logged in and do what I need to do. It's fine when connected to wifi but terrible on data. I've uninstalled the app and reinstalled it with no luck. PLEASE FIX!!! I will upgrade my review to 5 stars if this is resolved.

For a few months now there's been log on trouble. It constantly said no internet connection when I do. If it does magically work then it takes multiple attempts for it to work. It's incredibly slow and inconsistent when it works like it should. Very disappointed in the app TD Canada Trust. I shouldn't have to call easy web to get my online banking done.

Unless I'm connected to wifi I can't login. Just a message saying "you're not connected to the internet." Yet I can use my browser and every other app no problem. I've tried uninstalling & reinstalling the app, still the problem consists. What good is a mobile app that doesn't work when you're mobile? Absolute garbage.

reviews.t: App needs a lot of improvements
reviews.x: As much as I love TD, I really dislike their app compared to other banks like Scotiabank. I find it non user-friendly and slow compared to other banking apps. It’s very tedious trying to get around with the continuous loading every-time you tap something. I really hope they work on a more user-friendly interface with easier navigation and quicker response times.

Overall it's a good app and I can do what I need to do. But lately I noticed the money deposited into my account isn't showing as green, just the regular grey text. I find its harder to tell if money is coming into the account or leaving it. Not sure if it's the Google Pixel phone or a TD app update, but I think this needs to change back as it could lead to a lot of problems for a lot of people.

I've noticed an issue for the past few weeks. The TD app displays a "no internet connection" error when I am using my carrier LTE connection. Without WiFi, I am unable to consistently use the app. I have confirmed my data is working on other applications by checking for live updates and performing searches in chrome. Device is a pixel 7 with android 13 (checked for an update again just now and latest installed) and I have the latest version of the TD app.

Love the app. Just some small things if you’re reading this TD: please show the conversion rate used at the time of the trade usd/cad and please show US stocks with a USD beside it or otherwise do something to make it clear. It’s a bit of a pain to buy American stocks in CAD. Please make it easier for conversions so I don’t have to guess or go back and forth with a conversion app and a calculator.

Functionality is limited, and although there's a phone in option; you need to go through more verification than if you call in yourself with your card number (so I don't use it anymore). There is a spending gauge, but it doesn't monitor ALL of your accounts/ transactions/ bill payments/ purchases, so it isn't accurate. Which is upsetting because it would be a nice feature to monitor your money!

App is messed up. For one thing, when I launched it, it didn't even ask me to log in! It just went to my account. The main issue is that when I touch the account to see transactions, like I always to, NOTHING HAPPENS!! I can't even get to my transactions, which is bad, because I need to confirm if I was just double charged where I just shopped. BAD! If my phone was lost and someone got into it, THEY'D HAVE FULL ACCESS TO MY ACCOUNT AND INFORMATION!!!

The Android app for TD is garbage. It's been down for two days. The app is inaccurate and lies about credit available, etc. Its all just a gimmick to increase service charges and fees. Now they gave added alerts, not so that you can prevent extra fees, just to let you know how much you're increasing their profits.

Everytime I use this app, things change for the worse. I've never filled out a form where I had to click on another input box to activate the disabled submit button, usually it should do an update while I type. Also when clicking on some inputs, it will clear the value, rather than adding a cursor after it, super annoying. Also when doing maintenance, it's best to perhaps do it when most of Canada is asleep, for the least impact as possible.

reviews.t: This app sucks compared to other banks apps
reviews.x: I have no clue on why this is so highly rated. The app frequently goes down for hours, I always have an issue, transferring money, and it’s layout is poorly made

Mobile paypass randomly stops working! I would have to delete and re-download the app (plus log back in) in order for paypass to work on my phone. This happens at least twice a week. It's really disappointing and annoying. Also the oddest part is that prior to this I went an entire year being able go use paypass on my whole then one day it stopped working and then the reoccuring issue persisted. And now they're completely taken it away. Unless you have samsung or apple psy you CANNOT use PayPass

Same as everybody else, the mobile payment did not work for a long time, just show to be temporary unavailable after using for a few times. Please solve the problem. Now is the EMT not working, keep loading without internet problem. I guess it might due to my update to android 12. I think they need to update the app to fix the problems.

Update: uninstall and reinstall fixed, but annoying to have to do that. Multiple days of being unable to sign in. Not sure what happened, it used to work fine. Now whenever I try to sign in I get a pop up saying it's unable to sign me in right now. This has persisted for days. Very inconvenient and worrying.

Minimum payment for line-of-credit is hard to find and I underpaid my bill as a result. Please make the minimum payment amount immediately clear when go to my line-of-credit on app. A similar format to credit cards would work great - it is helpful to see the minimum payment amount without needing to open the statement document.

I like the app for what I do with it. I must say that having seen the RBC app ads I would like to have the added ability to turn my cards on and off I case they are misplaced. It would also be nice to be able to be notified for approval of transactions on my debit card. Not sure if that's possible but it would be a nice addition. I like that I can use fingerprint scanner to log in. Alao, why are TD cards not useable on Google Wallet?

I use an android and have used the app for many years never a problem. About two weeks ago the numerical amounts of any payments made either in store or a bill paid became unreadable because of numbers on top of each other. I have tried to decrease screen size, turn view to horizontal in hopes of creating more room so that numbers can "spread out" but to no avail. Also the choose view option for accounts under settings will not open. Right now the app is almost useless to me.

Most information is a day late as in transactions posting or transfers but then the finger points to the system as a whole not just the app . Crashing alot lately when you need it the most it will not work , shoddy app. Transferred money and did not go where intended , then fees on top fees . No improvement over 3 years.

Trying to use a visa as day to day while trying to help track on this app is brutal. Posted and pending transactions are all over the place and do not update correctly, sometimes the posted transactions still stay in pending as well and randomly come off so you can never truly know what you owe. If it moves to a posted transaction it should immediately come off pending.

Whenever I transfer money into my joint account with my wife, the transaction and account value don’t update immediately. I usually have to close the App and re-open again for the account value to properly update.

Used to work fine but as of the last month or so it has completely stopped letting me log in. Just gives me an error message telling me to try again later. The thing is TD, people rely on this for their banking. I'm fortunate enough to have a desktop PC, so this problem is somewhat mitigated in my case. However an issue like this could completely lock someone out of the banking system they rely on for everything. Not cool, please investigate this.

Fingerprint scanner broke and I had to use my password which is no problem. Only I have to reset my password every time I want to log in if I want to do any online banking or view my accounts. The login only takes reset passwords. If you logout and then want to go back in that new password you just made doesn't work and you have to reset your password again. Fix this and my rating will go up.

Transaction Limit BLOCKS larger REFUNDS. Proved it with TD Support on the phone while in the TD App. The Transaction Limit setting to limit purchase price has a program glitch. It also Limits REFUNDS. It limits the value of your transactions positive (purchases) and negative (refunds). This is wrong. A Transaction Limit is set to prevent purchases above a set threshold. Not to prevent refunds!! What’s worse, it’s not obvious. No “Limit Set” message just DECLINED. TD Support will say it looks like your card is blocked and not know why. Expect problems with refunds if you are using a Transaction Limit. This is ridiculous. Easy fix.
I use my TD everyday . I love it . Too bad there are things we still have to do on a computer . But overall all good !

Easy, fast and secure service. I love that I can check on all of my accounts seamlessly; transfers, payments, cheque deposits are all made extremely simple from anywhere. This is one of very few apps that has never crashed on me or caused other issues, in many years now. An easy 5 stars.

Terrible customer service. The app doesn't have options to view account numbers or the ability to stop payments. When you go into the branch they can't help you, and when you call customer service they give you information that contradicts what the teller told you. Wasted an hour of my day just to not get any help.
There is no dark theme available. It’s been more than a year now since iOS have it.

Thinking of switching banks. Price for account fees are pretty high for unlimited account for the aveage worker. Inpatient to hear from their customers for PtP. Has gone downhill significantly since covid hit hard in Canada. No faith in this bank anymore. App runs smoothly for the most part, not the easiest to navigate when first using the app. Edit, called easyline and add a representative cause a mini-breakdown.
Other credit cards can email me notification of any transaction - which is extremely useful. From the TD app I just get useless marketing notifications.
It would be nice to have at last Dark Mode implemented, a most have for customers with sensitive eyes and older customers. Thank you so much.

reviews.t: New balance does no reflect in real-time.
reviews.x: Suppose my balance is in negative and loaded up with some buffer amount to be positive (-50$ it’s showing and added 70$) so I should expect 20$ as a balance on top of it. But it didn’t happen. It’s taking approx 2-3 minutes I believe and I did a another try of bank transfer to see what happen, but still same. After refreshing many times and waiting for a longer period 2-3 minutes then it showed up the real balance. Issue impact is not high. Severity is also low. Comments: it creates confusion from user perspective.
Would like notifications for withdrawals and deposits like the other banking apps

The worst banking app I've used. Scheduled payments do not show up as having been taken out until the following day, making it easy for them to charge you with an NFS charge if you forgot it was coming out. BMO shows those charges at the beginning of the day giving you plenty of time to get your finances straight. So TD has no excuses, it's predatory financial practices plain and simple.

App is easy to use. Keeps me informed about where I'm spending and if I've spent more than usual in certin areas..I love being able to mobile deposit a cheque(unless its from a different country). I think its great i can pay my bills easily and keep track of the dates and the last time I made a payment towards something that way I dont have late charges. I love the app personally.

I can't use the mobile wallet anymore. It doesn't even open... And even then I could only use my Visa card and not debit. But for some reason you guys are selfish and won't let us use any of your cards on Samsung pay. Thanks for that. Edited to add that every once in a while for days at a time I can't open the app. It won't let me log in. Horrible design.

PLEASE FIX THIS PROBLEM PLEASE FIX THE PROBLEM PLEASE FIX THE PROBLEM When I try to log in I'm getting a message saying "while you were gone we logged you out." It's been about 2 months of this on and off. I've updated the app. Ive uninstalled and downloaded the app a couple more times and still I'm getting that same message or one saying I've timed out of my session. This is a serious problem and it needs to be fixed!!! It's stressing me tf out! It's causing me to miss payments and transfers.

I like the information available to decide which stocks to pick and otherwise avoid. I wish, however, that there was a place to go to see a list of all stocks on the TSX, DJIA or NASDAQ... by price, by dividend... Always room for improvement. Also love the learning centre, I may have to try options one of these days if I get brave! But I'm not much of a gambler preferring high dividend paying blue chip stocks. A bit boring perhaps but very stable over time. Cheers, keep up the good work!

Terrible Bank. TD does not update transactions that occur after 4pm. So if someone takes money out, it doesnt show until the next day. Yet in the account it still shows the available balance. For example I have $2500avaialble and am making a purchase. But only $2400 is actually available because I bought a $100 item. So I know the money is gone. It was a purchase at a store. Fix your app to reflect REAL TIME DATA. There is no excuse for this anymore. Everything is automated.

App keeps freezing or does not always process my trades nor transactions. Tech issues with the app although my phone is a recent/new one ... i did the whole uninstall/reinstall, etc. I still have to go the long way with the website & 2-WV for each time i log in from the exact same device. That causes delays to catch a price when trying to trade.... anyways we'll see what other apps(banks) have to offer.

I got a new phone so when I went to log-in to the app, it asked me to enable biometrics. When I either click enable or cancel, a page pops up that says "it's not you, it's us" so now there's no way I can log in. I have tried everything to fix it but nothing's working. This is very disappointing.

I can't log into the app for a week, can not get any information about it The problem is solved now by uninstall and install again. I looked for assistance from online customer service team who told me it's not my own problem but the whole system. The telephone numbers are always busy and at least half hour wait. No other way to get help with an easy tenical issue.

Very good. Does everything it's supposed to. I have experience with another banking app in Asia. ABA. And you can pay using the app QR codes, create and use virtual cards, pay bills, transfer easily, top up my phone, and many other things easily using the app. It would be nice if TD app would look into expanding what the app can do. As long as it doesn't compromise the safety of the app.

reviews.t: Great app with some archaic features
reviews.x: The call-in through the app, which I used to use all the time, does not support eSim. eSim has been available for years. Dear TD, call-in through app feature saves YOU time, and also your customers, if you care

I have been trying to get onto both the TD app and Online banking for the last 4 days. Both are asking me for a new temporary password and then kick me out with a pop up saying "It's not you, it's us. Try again later" I am so pissed off! I can't access to pay my bills! It's not like TD is going to pay my late fees. Fix the problem already! I've tried everything; uninstall and reinstall, shut off my phone, etc. I'm about ready to change banks over this.
I don’t see any feature to send alerts for any of my TD transactions (debit and credit). I will have to migrate my accounts to other banks now.

The app works fine for basic stuff, but TD still refuses to use other mobile payment apps (Google Pay, Samsung Pay, etc.). Second, why should I create a contact for every transfer I want to do? Most are just one off things, but means I have to enter all that info in a separate screen and then go back and delete after the transfer - if I remember.
